title: Numbers 0 to 10
description: Cardinal numbers 0 to 10. For 1 to 5 the palm faces you; for 6 to 9 it faces out.

review.notes: Awaiting review by a Deaf signer. Regional and contextual variants exist.

items.handshape: Fingertips curve to touch the thumb, forming an O.
tips: Same handshape as the letter O.

items.handshape: Index finger straight up; other fingers and thumb closed.
tips: For counting 1 to 5 the palm faces you, so the camera sees the back of your hand.
Your thumb rests over your folded fingers.

items.handshape: Index and middle fingers up and spread; thumb holds the other fingers.
tips: Same handshape as V, turned round so the palm faces you.
Your thumb holds down your ring and pinky fingers.

items.handshape: Thumb, index and middle fingers extended; ring and pinky closed.
tips: ASL 3 uses the thumb, not the ring finger.
Three fingers up without the thumb is 6 or W.

items.handshape: Four fingers up and spread; thumb folded across the palm.
tips: Tuck your thumb across your palm. With the thumb out it is a 5.
Palm faces you, fingers a little apart.

items.handshape: All five fingers extended and spread.
tips: Open hand, thumb out to the side. With the thumb tucked in it is a 4.

items.handshape: Pinky tip touches the thumb tip; index, middle and ring fingers up and spread.
tips: For 6 to 9 the palm faces out.
6 and the letter W share a handshape.

items.handshape: Ring fingertip touches the thumb tip; the other fingers up and spread.
tips: Your ring fingertip meets your thumb; keep the other three fingers up.

items.handshape: Middle fingertip touches the thumb tip; the other fingers up and spread.
tips: Your middle fingertip meets your thumb; keep the other three fingers up.

items.handshape: Index fingertip touches the thumb tip; the other fingers up and spread.
tips: 9 and the letter F share a handshape.

items.handshape: Fist with the thumb pointing straight up.
items.movement: Shake or twist the wrist slightly.
tips: Like the letter A with the thumb up, plus a small shake.
